Messages.Author: Pullen
Messages.Body:
Corkage
Master.
Investment.
Unique.
Put this card on a ready vampire you control. Every time this vampire successfully hunts add a counter to this card. The number of counters on this card can not exceed 3 or the capacity of this vampire, whichever is lower. During your untap phase you may tap this vampire to to burn this card and gain pool equal to the number of counters on this card.

I think this could be another alternative to Blood Doll for multi-action decks or decks with a lot of smallish vamps(3-6 caps). A pool cost of one could be added to in and the counter size upped to 4 to keep it from being abused by winnes.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr

> Ohlmann wrote:
> But if the card is playable, it will be better than blood doll in some case, so adding it is eother problematic because bloat is already too present, pr pointless because it's only abused in some specific deck.
>
That's a little narrowly focused, IMO.

Imagine a (hypothetical) new bloat card was attractive to some very weak archetypes at the moment (ideally making them much more playable), but which wasn't attractive to the top tier of play. It wouldn't necessarily increase the amount of bloat in the game, just its diversity - the player who would have played StrongArchetype+BloodDoll is now playing WeakArchetype+NewBloat.

The trick, of course, is finding a niche that helps out some decks without overpowering others.
